name: ProReviewer
subtitle: From Passive Generation to **Investigation**
tagline: A peer-review agent that reviews papers the way experts do — **reading step by step, taking notes, and verifying claims before judging.**
blurb: ProReviewer formulates peer review as a **Markov Decision Process**: the paper is an **environment**, and the agent keeps a structured working memory — a **review log** — across many steps. **What is unresolved in that log decides where it reads next**, and every point in the final review is assembled from the entries it settled.

install.title: As a skill
install.note: No GPU. Install into a CLI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI).

install.title: Against an API
install.note: No GPU. Runs the agent loop against any model via litellm. Needs the repo and the full install.
install.code:
git clone https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2026-ProReviewer.git
cd arxiv2026-ProReviewer    # then README → Installation
cp config.toml.example config.toml    # add your API keys
python run_inference.py --model "anthropic/claude-opus-4" \
    --test_data data/test_data --output_dir outputs/reviews

install.title: Trained checkpoint
install.note: GPU required. Needs the repo and the full install, including CUDA and the verl/rLLM backends.
install.code:
git clone https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2026-ProReviewer.git
cd arxiv2026-ProReviewer    # then README → Installation
python run_inference.py --model <path-to-checkpoint> \
    --test_data data/test_data --output_dir outputs/reviews --n_runs 4
